bio-imm-01-c1.text: Jean S. Marshall, Richard Warrington, Wade Watson, Harold L. Kim (2018). An introduction to immunology and immunopathology. Allergy, Asthma & Clinical Immunology 14(Suppl 2).
bio-imm-01-c1.quote: It is a rapid immune response, initiated within minutes or hours after aggression, that has no immunologic memory.
bio-imm-01-c1.claim: Within minutes to hours of an infection, the body's innate immune system is already responding.
